text:
sam: beginning staged rollout for inference-runtime v2.4.0 in change window 03:00-05:00 UTC. plan = 1% canary -> 5% -> 20% with 10m holds. release notes: https://internal/release-notes/2.4.0 (GC and batching tweaks). quick stop/go?

deploy-bot: Deploy started by @sam
Command: `/deploy start --service=inference-runtime --version=v2.4.0 --strategy=staged --steps=1,5,20 --window=03:00-05:00UTC --initiator=@sam`
Status: 1% canary deployed to regional subsets.

julia-eng: saw a small auth error increase in ap-southeast at ~90s after cutover, p50 fine but p99 elevated. digging into traces. :mag:

max-sre: alerts showing ap-southeast auth_errors up from 0.02% -> 0.45%. not huge but correlated with the cut. could be header size change from batching.

ops-lee: we can perform a region pin if needed. Example:
```
POST /routing/pin
{
  "service":"inference-runtime",
  "region":"ap-southeast-1",
  "version":"v2.3.5"
}
```

sam: proposal: hold expansion, pin ap-southeast to previous stable v2.3.5, continue 1% elsewhere. quick votes?

julia-eng: vote: pin. I'll run targeted trace capture and replay.

max-sre: vote: pin. tightening alerts and increasing sampling for traces in all regions.

pm-ana: vote: pin. will notify stakeholders if hold >15m.

deploy-bot: Routing pin requested by @ops-lee for ap-southeast-1 -> v2.3.5. status: in-progress.

deploy-bot: Routing pin completed for ap-southeast-1 -> v2.3.5, propagation confirmed.

sam: confirmed ap-southeast pinned. global canary remains at 1% elsewhere. cancel next step (5%) until triage results. contingency = full rollback if similar auth spike appears in US/EU. reopen thread with triage findings. :white_check_mark:
